name: WhatsApp (beta)
description: Notifications and replies over the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API. Needs a Meta developer app and the small Hive relay (a free Cloudflare Worker) to receive replies.

settings.label: Access token
settings.help: Meta app → WhatsApp → API Setup. Use a System User token so it doesn't expire after 24h.

settings.label: Phone number ID
settings.help: Meta app → WhatsApp → API Setup → Phone number ID (not the phone number itself).

settings.label: Your WhatsApp number
settings.help: Country code + number, digits only. Only this number can answer Hive.

settings.label: Relay URL
settings.help: Where you deployed relay/whatsapp-relay from the Hive repo.

settings.label: Relay secret
settings.help: The RELAY_SECRET you set on the relay.

settings.label: Wake-up template (optional)
settings.help: WhatsApp only lets businesses message you within 24h of your last message. Outside that window Hive sends this approved template and delivers the real message once you reply.

docs:
WhatsApp needs more setup than Slack or Telegram. See plugins/notify-whatsapp/README.md in the Hive repo.

Short version:
1. Create a Meta developer app with the WhatsApp product and a business phone number.
2. Deploy relay/whatsapp-relay (Cloudflare Worker) and point the app's webhook at <relay>/webhook.
3. Fill in the fields below, enable, and Send test message.

WhatsApp's 24-hour rule: Hive can only message you freely within 24h of your last message to the business number. Send it any message to open the window, or set a wake-up template.
